highlights.title: Notifications open the right chat
highlights.text: When a bot needs you, its notification now opens the team chat, channel, thread or direct chat where it asked. An approval scrolls to its card.

highlights.title: Pre-push checks in team chats
highlights.text: A team chat now shows one line for each bot's newest pre-push check, the ones that need you first. Open takes you to the card in that bot's chat.

highlights.title: One look per bot
highlights.text: Each bot now has the same avatar everywhere: in the sidebar, its replies, the working line, the cards and the Ask chips.

fixes: A follow-up turn no longer asks again for a picture the change already shared.
"Try again" picks a change up again, even after you cancelled it. "Stop" and "no" don't.
The working line names the bot when you open a chat while it's replying.
On a phone, the working line sits in the message box, as on the desktop.
